# ديوان الشاعر سمير الشيخ حسين

> Arabic poetry collection (ديوان) by the poet Sameer Alsheikh Hussein, written on classical Arabic meters (بحور الخليل بن أحمد). All content is Arabic (RTL).

## الشاعر (The Poet)

سمير الشيخ حسين — شاعر عربي. This site hosts his collected poems (diwan).

## الأبواب (Categories)

- غزل (ghazal) — love poetry: /category/ghazal
- وجدانية (wijdaniya) — emotional: /category/wijdaniya
- وطنية (wataniya) — patriotic: /category/wataniya
- مدح (madh) — praise: /category/madh
- رثاء (ritha) — elegy: /category/ritha
- هجاء (hija) — satire: /category/hija
- روحية (ruhiya) — spiritual: /category/ruhiya

## القصائد (Poems)

Each poem lives at /poem/<slug> and consists of numbered verses (أبيات). Each verse has two hemistichs: الصدر (sadr) and العجز (ajz).
